Predict and fill unknown labels using a trained random forest model

Source: R/model_training.R
predict_unknown_with_randomforest.Rd

Use a trained ranger classification model to predict cell-type labels for all cells in a SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment object. Predicted labels are used to fill entries in label_col that are either NA or equal to unknown_label.

Usage

predict_unknown_with_randomforest(
  spe,
  model,
  assay_name = "exprs",
  label_col = "custom_label",
  out_col = "soft_tree_label_filled",
  pred_col = "rf_pred",
  unknown_label = "Unknown",
  threshold = 0.5,
  unassigned_label = "Unassigned"
)

Arguments

spe

A SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment object.

model

A fitted ranger model returned by train_custom_rf(). The model should be trained with probability = TRUE to enable threshold-based filtering.

assay_name

Character scalar specifying which assay to use as feature input (default "exprs").

label_col

Character scalar naming the existing label column in colData(spe) (default "custom_label").

out_col

Character scalar naming the output column that will contain the filled labels (default "soft_tree_label_filled").

pred_col

Character scalar naming the column used to store raw model predictions (default "rf_pred").

unknown_label

Character value treated as missing and eligible for replacement (default "Unknown").

threshold

Numeric value in [0,1] specifying the minimum required class probability for a prediction to be accepted (default 0.5). Ignored if the model was not trained with probability = TRUE.

unassigned_label

Character label assigned to cells whose maximum class probability is below threshold (default "Unassigned").

Value

The input spe object with updated colData columns:

pred_col

Raw predicted labels from the random forest.

out_col

Filled labels, replacing only NA or unknown_label entries in label_col.

rf_confidence

Maximum predicted class probability per cell.

Details

If the model was trained with probability = TRUE, class probabilities are used to compute a confidence score for each prediction. Predictions with maximum class probability below threshold are reassigned to unassigned_label. The maximum probability is stored for quality control.

Feature columns are automatically aligned to match the variables used during model training. Only cells originally labeled as NA or unknown_label are replaced in the output column.

Examples

# \donttest{
data("cytoGateR_example", package = "cytoGateR")
image_ids <- SummarizedExperiment::colData(cytoGateR_example)$image_name
spe <- cytoGateR_example[, image_ids == image_ids[1L]]
fit <- train_custom_randomforest(
  spe,
  label_col = "core_group",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  features = c("CD3e", "CD20", "CD4", "CD8a"),
  num.trees = 25,
  cv_folds = 2,
  repeats = 1,
  agreement_thresh = 0,
  num_threads = 1,
  seed = 1
)
#> Processing 1378 core cells via 1 repeated CV folds...
#> Training final model on 1378 cleaned cells...
prediction <- predict_unknown_with_randomforest(
  fit$spe,
  fit$model,
  label_col = "cleaned_core_label",
  unknown_label = "Unassigned",
  threshold = 0.5
)
table(SummarizedExperiment::colData(prediction$spe)$soft_tree_label_filled)
#> 
#>       Bcell     BnTcell         CD4         CD8     Myeloid  Neutrophil 
#>         578        1389         422         391         230          12 
#> Plasma_cell      Stroma        Treg       Tumor  Unassigned 
#>          41         330         230          27         713 
# }
